source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Whenever the unit containing this model Advances, skip its [Advance roll](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move); its models get +6" M for the rest of the phase instead.

Whenever one of its models makes a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or [Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back), it can pass horizontally over models and terrain features during that move, but it cannot stop on top of a model or a model's base.

detail.actor: unit of Overlord with Translocation Shroud
